options.name: APIRegionName
options.description: OCI region name to be used for listing available regions

options.name: authFingerprint
options.description: Fingerprint of API Keys. Format is 12:34:56:78:90:ab:cd:ef:12:34:56:78:90:ab:cd:ef, can be found in Identity->Users->User Details->API Keys

options.name: authKeyContent
options.description: API private key file's content (PEM format) to connect to OCI

options.name: authTenancy
options.description: Usually one company will have a single tenancy. Format is ocid1.tenancy.oc1..<unique ID>, can be found in https://cloud.oracle.com/tenancy

options.name: authUser
options.description: User ocid. Format is ocid1.user.oc1..<unique ID>, can be found in Profile->User Settings

options.name: cloneFrom
options.description: The id or name of the entity that the new entity will be cloned from.  (take effect only at entity creation)

options.name: defaultCompartmentId
options.description: Default compartment ID used, others are listed in https://cloud.oracle.com/identity/compartments.

options.name: defaultNodeInstallerImageId
options.description: Default node-installer image, can be overridden in cloudsettings

options.name: defaultRegion
options.description: Default region to start virtual machine in.

options.name: imagesCompartmentId
options.description: Compartment OCID to search for custom images

options.name: imagesManifestBaseURL
options.description: Base URL to download images manifests

options.name: securityGroupNode
options.description: Security group ID of the cloud nodes

options.name: state
options.description: The state the resource should have

options.name: tags
options.description: List of tags that will be assigned to all resources created by BCM under this cloud provider
